messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER — INFRA-5023: runtime 5xx spike in west-1 (12% error rate). Alert: https://dash.redwood.internal/alerts/INFRA-5023. Paging eng-oncall primary.

Amanda.lee: I'm on my last 15m of shift, handing off. Quick snapshot: saw elevated 5xx starting ~02:12 UTC, restarted runtime-pool-3 once (node flapped), temporarily routed traffic to fallback pool. Customer impact: degraded responses for <10% of requests (some timeouts).

Amanda.lee: Actions taken: restarted pool, bumped concurrency cap on fallback, added temporary route rule. No config changes. Logs show repeated `kv-cache` errors in logs.

Sanjay.kumar: I'm incoming primary. I'll take driver. Picking up traces + heap dumps.

Sanjay.kumar: Plan: 1) reproduce with traffic replay on staging, 2) collect pprof / logs from affected instances, 3) dig into kernel OOM / eviction patterns. If we see >15% 5xx for more than 10m escalate to eng-sre-manager.

Leo.zheng: I'll own external comms / customer updates. Will draft an ETA note and post to #status-updates. @Sanjay please ping me when we have a clear mitigation to include. :thumbsup:

Nora: Runbook pointer: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/runtime-5xx (see "Troubleshooting kv-cache eviction" section). Quick commands:```bash
# list runtime pods
rctrl get pods -n runtime | grep runtime
# tail logs for pod
rctrl logs -n runtime runtime-pod-3 -f --since=10m
# check node metrics
rctrl metrics nodes west-1 --filter=memory,cpu,io
```

Nora: Note: fallback pool has lower qps capacity — watch latency on fallback.

Amanda.lee: Coverage gap: APAC on-call secondary not available for next 2h (OOO). If this grows, request support from EU oncall backup. I've left a sticky note in the incident tracker with that.

Sanjay.kumar: Creating incident channel #incident-runtime-5023 now and linking this thread. Setting metadata: driver=Sanjay, comms=Leo, secondary=Nora.

Leo.zheng: Drafted initial customer blurb, will post after we confirm mitigation plan.

Amanda.lee: Leaving now — handoff complete. Driver + comms assigned, I put brief notes in the runbook. :wave:

Sanjay.kumar: Acknowledged. Taking lead. Will post updates every 10m or when status changes. If anyone sees a config rollback or new deploy, shout here immediately. :eyes:

eng-sre-manager: If you need an extra pair, ping me and I'll join. Keep ticket updated with root-cause hypotheses and mitigation steps.

incident-bot: Incident channel created: #incident-runtime-5023. Incident ticket INFRA-5023 opened (severity: P1). Follow runbook and tag `owner=driver` and `comms=owner` in ticket. :sos:
